title: 15 Years of Algorithmic Fairness: Scoping Review of Interdisciplinary Developments in the Field
findings: The paper's analysis of 1570 articles on algorithmic fairness found that religion is an almost entirely unexamined demographic category. It was identified as the focus of only a single paper, placing it under the 'Other' demographic category alongside topics like economic status and nationality, highlighting a significant gap in the research field.

measurement_description: This paper is a scoping review and does not conduct its own benchmark measurement. It analyzes existing literature on algorithmic fairness and identifies 'Religion' as a demographic category that has been the focus of only one paper in their sample of 1570, indicating it is a severely under-researched area.
